tools.name: talexio_list_organisation_units
tools.description: List the active organisation units (departments, sites, companies) of the client. Their ids are the organisationUnitId filter for the other tools. Talexio API: GET /payroll/organisation-units.

tools.name: talexio_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with their payroll fields and the positions that overlap the period. periodFrom and periodTo are yyyy-mm-dd; payrollPeriod is required. Only positions with that pay frequency are returned. Talexio API: GET /payroll/employees.

tools.name: talexio_list_payroll_approvals
tools.description: List approved timesheet pay lines per employee, computed the same way as Talexio payslips: hours at day-type rates, overtime, allowances, and penalty rows (negative). Filter by approval date. periodFrom and periodTo are yyyy-mm-dd, at most 92 days apart. Times are in Europe/Malta. Results are groupe

tools.name: talexio_list_time_off
tools.description: List approved leave records in a date range, so a planner knows who is away. Only approved leave appears. Cancelled leave is left out unless includeCancelled is true. dateFrom and dateTo are yyyy-mm-dd; the range is at most 366 days. Talexio API: GET /ta/time-off-data.

tools.name: talexio_list_shift_templates
tools.description: List the shift templates the token user can see, ordered by name. Their ids are used when a roster is planned. The list is limited to the units the user works in. Talexio API: GET /ta/shift-templates.
